description: An expander for the TM Rythm sequencer, giving a gate from each of the top eight bits of its register plus four jacks combining some of them; it goes immediately to the right of the sequencer

outputs.text: 10V while either the sixth or the seventh bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while either the fourth or the sixth bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while either the top bit of the register or the fourth bit down from it is high
10V while any of the top bit, the fourth, the sixth or the seventh bit down from it is high
10V while the eighth bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the seventh bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the sixth bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the fifth bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the fourth bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the third bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the second bit down from the top of the register is high
10V while the top bit of the register is high, which is the bit the sequencer's own pulse output follows

notes: this expander does nothing unless a TM Rythm is its immediate left neighbour; with anything else there, or nothing, every output is held at 0V
menu: Gate Mode: Gate, Tap — Gate holds each output high for as long as its bit is high; Tap turns every output into a 50ms pulse fired each time its bit changes state
